_comment: KEA PGCET cutoff sources, discovered 2026-08-26. Each year uses a DIFFERENT naming scheme -- do not assume a pattern generalises. 2020-2022 have no cutoff PDFs published. 2026 counselling had not started as of 2026-08-26 (provisional result 19-08-2026), so no 2026 cutoffs exist yet.

2025.note: Three variants exist per course and seat type. '<name>kannada.pdf' is FIRST ROUND, '<name>_FIN.pdf' is SECOND ROUND, and '<name>_30092025kannada.pdf' is the MOCK allotment -- the mock is deliberately excluded, it allots nothing. Course letter in the filename: B = MBA, C = MCA, T = M.Tech.

_dead.2019: KEA links pgcet_2019/R1_cutoff_*.pdf but the files 404. Verified 2026-08-26.

mat_colleges.what: AIMA's own list of institutes accepting MAT, in four regions.
mat_colleges.gives: acceptance only — AIMA publishes no per-institute cutoff and no route strength
